$comment: The contributor community (/contributing/; /roles/, /pin/ and /contributors/ redirect here). Unlisted (noindex, not linked from the program page) until the board approves the levels. Learning by doing, applied to The Labs itself: anyone can contribute, and each level means you've worked hands-on in more of its workstreams, major and minor. The pins are the symbol: one section walks the levels, by scroll or by picking one, with a pin you can drag (live 3D on desktop). Summarises design/research/recognition-system.md. [PLACEHOLDER] marks what's still open.
title: Contributing
description: Learn by doing, on The Labs itself. Anyone can pitch in, beginners and experts side by side, and each level means you've had your hands on more of how The Labs runs.
draft: A working draft. The board hasn't approved the levels or the workstreams yet, and the pins are still being made.

title: Build
The Labs
hero.lede: At The Labs you learn by doing, and that includes helping run the place. Come as you are. Grow as far as you like.
hero.status: First pins: our two steering committees
hero.pinAlt: The Contributing Member pin, turning to follow your pointer

why.title: A community you can actually show up to.

items.label: In person
items.title: Close to home.
items.body: You'll work with people from your neighborhood, face to face, not just in a chat window.

items.label: Side by side
items.title: Beginners and experts, together.
items.body: Learn from people who've done it. Teach what you know.

items.label: Hands-on
items.title: Learning is the point.
items.body: Every job here teaches you something, and AI tools help you build more than you'd expect.

items.label: Local
items.title: Real problems, real neighbors.
items.body: What you make helps someone you might pass on the street.

start.title: Some people use the playbook. Some write the next page.
start.lede: Pick a way in. They all count.

items.label: Contribute
items.title: Make something better.
items.body: A guide, a flyer, a talk, a bit of code. Anyone can suggest a change, and we'll credit you by name.

items.label: Take a role
items.title: Try it for real.
items.body: Upskiller, Poderator, Mentor or Ambassador. You'll get trained, then get plenty of practice. Ambassador is open now.

items.label: Share what you know
items.title: Already an expert?
items.body: Mentor a pod, look over work in your field, and help newer people find their feet. Your time counts, and we'll recognize it.

items.label: Get recognized
items.title: Earn the pin.
items.body: When The Labs runs on something you've given, the people who saw it put your name forward.

rings.title: Every level is more of The Labs, hands on.
rings.lede: Each level means you've worked in more parts of The Labs. Go as far as you like: plenty of people find the role they love and stay there.

steps.line: Something you gave is part of how The Labs runs.
steps.how: Your work, your time, or your know-how made a real difference. We write down what it was.
steps.trusted: Vouching for people who are ready for the next level.

steps.line: You've done it, so you can check it.
steps.how: Hands-on in two major workstreams, with two pin holders backing you.
steps.trusted: Looking over work in the areas you know, and helping newer people get there.

steps.line: You've seen every part of The Labs up close.
steps.how: Hands-on in every major workstream, and some of the smaller ones.
steps.trusted: Saying yes to changes in your Lab's playbooks, and mentoring Reviewers.

steps.line: You know how it all fits together.
steps.how: Hands-on across the board. Other Maintainers put you forward, and the board confirms.
steps.trusted: Setting the direction for a workstream, with the board keeping the final say.

rings.names: Workstreams and level names are still drafts. Major workstreams (draft): Build Cycle, Learning Pathways, Community & Outreach, Platform (OLOS), Operations & Governance. Smaller ones include events, communications and research. [PLACEHOLDER]

picker.stageLabel: The {rank} pin. Drag, or use the arrow keys, to turn it.

given.title: It starts with the work. It ends with a handshake.

steps.title: Do the work.
steps.body: Give your time, your skills, or something you made.

steps.title: Two people back you.
steps.body: Sponsors who already wear the pin help you get there, then vouch that you did.

steps.title: We write it down.
steps.body: Your Lab checks it, and it goes on the record with a line about what you did.

steps.title: Pinned.
steps.body: At the next regional gathering. Your sponsors pin it on and say a few words.

given.note: There's no rush. Take the time it takes, and every kind of help counts.

status.title: Every level is active or emeritus.
status.lede: Your level is yours for good. The only question is whether you're doing the work right now.

items.label: Active
items.title: In the thick of it.
items.body: You have a seat in your Lab, and the say that comes with your level.

items.label: Emeritus
items.title: Taking a step back.
items.body: You keep your level, your pin, and your voice. Come back whenever there's a seat open.

decides.title: A few things that won't change.
rules: Levels don't come with a vote. The boards look after programs, money, people and the brand.
No one can buy a pin, a level, or a vote.
This is a thank-you from the community, not a certificate.
The only way to lose a level is a serious breach of the Code of Conduct.

join.title: Every pin starts with one contribution.
join.lede: Right now the way in is the ambassador program. Share your story, bring someone to their first workshop, and see what you end up building.

footer.renders: Images of the pin are 3D renders, not photos. The real pins are still being made.
